name: Ability Shield
description: A held item that prevents the holder's ability from being changed or suppressed by any effect.

name: Absorb Bulb
description: A held item that raises the holder's Special Attack by one stage when hit by a damaging Water-type move.

name: Air Balloon
description: A held item that causes the holder to be ungrounded, meaning that they cannot be affected by damaging Ground-type moves and any other ground-related effects. If the holder is hit by a damaging move, the Air Balloon will pop, removing its effects. The item itself, however, will not be destroyed and will return to normal once the battle ends.

name: Assault Vest
description: A held item that raises the Special Defense of the Pokémon holding it by 50%, but prevents the holder from selecting any status move.

name: Big Root
description: A held item that increases the HP recovered from the holder's draining moves by 30%.

name: Binding Band
description: A held item that causes binding moves used by the holder to inflict 1/6 of the target's health instead of the usual 1/8 of the target's health at the end of each turn.

name: Black Belt
description: A held item that increases the power of the holder's Fighting-type moves by 20%.

name: Black Glasses
description: A held item that increases the power of the holder's Dark-type moves by 20%.

name: Black Sludge
description: A held item that heals Poison-types by 1/16 of their maximum HP at the end of each turn. If the holder is not a Poison-type Pokémon, it will lose 1/8 of its maximum HP instead.

name: Blunder Policy
description: A held item that increases the holder's Speed by two stages when one of the holder's moves misses a target due to an accuracy or evasion check.

name: Bright Powder
description: A held item that causes the opponent's attacks targeted at the holder to have a 10% extra reduction in accuracy.

name: Cell Battery
description: A held item that increases the holder's Attack by one stage when hit by a damaging Electric-type move.

name: Charcoal Stick
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Fire-type moves by 20%.

name: Choice Band
description: A held item that boosts the Attack of the Pokémon holding it by 50%, but only allows the use of the first move selected each time it is sent into battle.

name: Choice Scarf
description: A held item that boosts the Speed of the Pokémon holding it by 50%, but only allows the use of the first move selected each time it is sent into battle.

name: Choice Specs
description: A held item that boosts the Special Attack of the Pokémon holding it by 50%, but only allows the use of the first move selected each time it is sent into battle.

name: Clear Amulet
description: A held item that prevents the holder from being affected by status conditions.

name: Covert Cloak
description: A held item that protects the holder from any additional effects from other Pokémon's damaging moves.

name: Damp Rock
description: A held item that increases the duration of rain from 5 turns to 8 turns, if the holder created the rain.

name: Destiny Knot
description: A held item that causes the opponent to be infatuated if the holder is infatuated.

name: Dragon Fang
description: A held item that increases the power of the holder's Dragon-type moves by 20%.

name: Eject Button
description: A held item that causes the holder to be switched out when hit by a damaging move.

name: Eject Pack
description: A held item that causes the holder to be switched out when their stats are lowered.

name: Everstone
description: A held item that prevents the holder from evolving.

name: Eviolite
description: A held item that increases the Defense and Special Defense of the holder by 50% if they are not fully evolved.

name: Exp. Share
description: A held item that allows the holder to share experience points with other Pokémon in the party as long as they are not fainted.

name: Expert Belt
description: A held item that boosts the damage of the holder's super effective moves by 20%.

name: Fairy Feather
description: A held item that increases the power of the holder's Fairy-type moves by 20%.

name: Flame Orb
description: A held item that causes the holder to be burned at the end of each turn.

name: Float Stone
description: A held item that halves the weight of the holder to a minimum of 0.1kg.

name: Focus Band
description: A held item that allows the holder to survive an attack that would otherwise cause it to faint, with 10% chance, leaving it at 1hp.

name: Focus Sash
description: A held item that, if the Pokémon is at full HP, allows the holder to survive an attack that would otherwise cause it to faint, with 10% chance, leaving it at 1hp.

name: Grip Claw
description: A held item that increases the duration of the user's trapping moves to 7 turns.

name: Hard Stone
description: A held item that increases the power of the holder's Rock-type moves by 20%.

name: Heat Rock
description: A held item that extends the duration of harsh sunlight from 5 turns to 8 turns, if the holder created the harsh sunlight.

name: Heavy Duty Boots
description: A held item that make the holder immune to entry hazards such as Stealth Rock, Spikes and Sticky Web.

name: Icy Rock
description: A held item that extends the duration of hail or snow from 5 turns to 8 turns, if the holder created the hail or snow.

name: Iron Ball
description: A held item that reduces the holder's Speed by 50%. It also causes the holder to be grounded and thus susceptible to Ground-type moves, Arena Trap, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and terrain, even if it is a Flying-type or is levitating.

name: Icy Rock
description: A held item which causes the holder to move last in its priority bracket.

name: Leftovers
description: A held item that heals 1/16 of the holder's maximum HP at the end of each turn.

name: Life Orb
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's moves by 30%, but causes the holder to take damage equal to 10% of its maximum HP after using a damaging move.

name: Light Ball
description: A held item that doubles Attack and Special Attack, if held by a Pikachu. This item has no effect if held by any other Pokémon.

name: Light Clay
description: A held item that extends the duration of the moves Reflect, Aurora Veil and Light Screen from five turns to eight turns when used by the holder.

name: Loaded Dice
description: A held item that causes the holder's multistrike moves to always hit at least four times, if possible.

name: Lucky Egg
description: A held item that boosts the amount of experience a Pokémon gains after battle by 50%.

name: Luminous Moss
description: A held item that raises the holder's Special Defense by one stage when hit by a damaging Water-type move.

name: Magnet
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Electric-type moves by 20%.

name: Mental Herb
description: A held item that cures the holder of infatuation and other mental effects. It will be consumed after use.

name: Metal Powder
description: A held item that increases Ditto's Defense and Special Defense by 50% when held.

name: Metronome
description: A held item that boosts the power of moves used consecutively by the Pokémon holding it by 20% for each previous, consecutive turn the move has been used successfully, up to a maximum increase of 100%.

name: Miracle Seed
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Grass-type moves by 20%.

name: Mirror Herb
description: A held item that copies all of the opponent's increased stats.

name: Muscle Band
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's physical moves by 10%.

name: Mystic Water
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Water-type moves by 20%.

name: Never-Melt Ice
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Ice-type moves by 20%.

name: Poison Barb
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Poison-type moves by 20%.

name: Power Anklet
description: A held item that gives extra Speed EVs when the holder participates in battle.

name: Power Band
description: A held item that gives extra Special Defense EVs when the holder participates in battle.

name: Power Belt
description: A held item that gives extra Defense EVs when the holder participates in battle.

name: Power Bracer
description: A held item that gives extra Attack EVs when the holder participates in battle.

name: Power Herb
description: A held item that allows the holder to immediately use a move that would normally require a turn to charge.

name: Power Lens
description: A held item that gives extra Special Attack EVs when the holder participates in battle.

name: Power Weight
description: A held item that gives extra HP EVs when the holder participates in battle.

name: Protective Pads
description: A held item that protects the holder from the effects of moves that make contact with the target.

name: Punching Glove
description: A held item that increases the power of the holder's punching moves by 10% and prevents contact with targets via these moves.

name: Quick Claw
description: A held item that grants the holder a 20% chance of moving first in its priority bracket.

name: Quick Powder
description: A held item that doubles an untransformed Ditto's Speed when held.

name: Red Card
description: A held item that causes the attacker to switch out if the holder is hit by another Pokémon's damaging move. The item only activates once per battle and will not activate if the attacker is a wild Pokémon or its Trainer has no Pokémon to switch in.

name: Ring Target
description: A held item that removes the holder's type immunities.

name: Rocky Helmet
description: A held item that causes Pokémon that use a contact move on the holder to take damage equal to 1/6 of their maximum HP.

name: Room Service
description: A held item that lowers the holders Speed by one stage if Trick Room is active. This item can only activate once per battle.

name: Safety Goggles
description: A held item that grants the holder immunity to powder and spore moves, as well as protection from damage caused by hail and sandstorm.

name: Scope Lens
description: A held item that increases the holder's critical hit ratio by one stage.

name: Sharp Beak
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Flying-type moves by 20%.

name: Shed Shell
description: A held item that allows the holder to switch out even if it is under the effects of a trapping move or ability. This does not, however, allow the player to flee or Teleport under these effects.

name: Shell Bell
description: A held item that restores HP equal to 1/8 of the damage dealt by the holder's damaging moves.

name: Silk Scarf
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves by 20%.

name: Silver Powder
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Bug-type moves by 20%.

name: Smoke Ball
description: A held item that guarantees the holder can flee from wild Pokémon.

name: Smooth Rock
description: A held item that extends the duration of sandstorms from 5 turns to 8 turns, if the holder created the sandstorm.

name: Smooth Rock
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Ground-type moves by 20%.

name: Soothe Bell
description: A held item that increases the holder's amount of friendship earned by 50%.

name: Spell Tag
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Ghost-type moves by 20%.

name: Sticky Barb
description: A held item that damages 1/8 of the holder's maximum HP at the end of each turn. If a Pokémon with no held item hits the holder with a contact move, the Sticky Barb is transferred to the attacker.

name: Terrain Extender
description: A held item that increases the duration of the holder's moves and abilities which create terrain to 8 turns.

name: Throat Spray
description: A held item that increases the holder's Special Attack by one stage when they use a sound-based move.

name: Toxic Orb
description: A held item that badly poisons its holder at the end of the turn. The holder does not take damage on the turn the status is inflicted.

name: Twisted Spoon
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's Psychic-type moves by 20%.

name: Utility Umbrella
description: A held item that causes the holder to ignore the effects of rain and harsh sunlight.

name: Weakness Policy
description: A held item that raises the holder's Attack and Special Attack by two stages when hit by a super-effective move. This can only activate once per battle.

name: White Herb
description: A held item that restores all of the holder's decreased stats.

name: Wide Lens
description: A held item that boosts the holder's accuracy by 10%.

name: Wise Glasses
description: A held item that boosts the power of the holder's special moves by 10%.

name: Zoom Lens
description: A held item that boosts the holder's accuracy by 20% against targets that have already used a move in the same turn.
